rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “perfectly” means completely or totally, especially before an adjective or verb phrase.

example.english: I perfectly understand what you mean.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 ming4 baak6 nei5 gong2 me1

rows.note: Use this when an action is carried out to a flawless or exceptionally high standard, as in “do it perfectly.”

example.english: You did your report perfectly, so it doesn't need any changes.
example.traditional: 你份報告做得好好，完全唔使改。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2 jyun4 cyun4 m4 sai2 goi2
